answer: A sybil operator time-shares one server across a thousand puppets — CPU is fungible, so the defense must tax what cannot be shared: RAM. Require every identity to maintain a memory-hard state root that grows each epoch, then present it at unpredictable simultaneous checkpoints, a marble of memory proving live commitment. A grove of puppets must hold a grove of distinct RAM at the same instant; you cannot time-slice what must all be alive at once. The honest pay one identity's RAM, the farm pays a thousand, and saffron emissions flow only to identities whose memory was truly there.
